study.title: Cross-domain transfer learning for weed segmentation and mapping in precision farming using ground and UAV images
study.short_title: Cross-Domain Transfer Learning for UAV Weed Mapping

segmentation.best_model: Proposed network (field-trained only, VGG16 init, weighted loss, CRF post-processing) transferred to UAV orthomosaic

dataset.name: Maize fields near Ghent & Merelbeke, Belgium (field: Nikon D7200, ~1 m; UAV: Sony Alpha 6000 on Hydra-12 Onyxstar, 20 m)
dataset.note: UAV data (ILVO Merelbeke 2016): 12-rotor Mikrokopter Hydra-12 Onyxstar + Sony Alpha 6000 (6000x4000, GSD 1.78 mm/px) at 20 m AGL, maize at 3-4 unfolded leaves; orthomosaic via Agisoft PhotoScan, cropped with 16x16 grid then resized to 512x512 tiles. Field source: >10,000 images (48 GB) from 4 maize fields; 5,000 512x512 train tiles + 621 validation images. Classes: weed, maize, soil.

mIoU.quote: The proposed network (0.617), UNet (0.601) and SegNet (0.609) achieved better mIOU values than the FCN family
mIoU.ambiguity: UAV-domain mIoU of field-trained proposed model (Table 3). Paper abstract reports UAV per-class IoU crop 0.596 / weed 0.407 / soil 0.875, which do not exactly match the class-wise recall/IoU columns of Table 3 (soil 0.815, weed 0.441, crop 0.596); mIoU 0.617 equals the mean of the Table-3 class column values, indicating an abstract/table conflation of IoU and recall.

mPA.ambiguity: Overall accuracy (OA) = 0.734 on UAV orthomosaic tiles for the proposed network; text defines mean pixel accuracy = overall accuracy.

PA.ambiguity: Overall accuracy captured under mPA (0.734, UAV).

weed_F1.ambiguity: Per-class metrics reported as IoU only (weed UAV IoU 0.407 per abstract).

fps.ambiguity: No real-time requirement; CRF post-processing adds ~35.8 ms on desktop GPU.

params_M.quote: There are 42,037,391 parameters in total with 42,018,441 trainable parameters
params_M.ambiguity: Structural metric for the proposed model (non-edge; no on-board deployment).

issues: Abstract vs Table 3 per-class UAV IoU inconsistency (crop 0.596 weed 0.407 soil 0.875 vs class columns soil 0.815 weed 0.441 crop 0.596); mIoU 0.617 is the Table-3 mean.
Model trained on ground-field images and transferred; UAV numbers are cross-domain transfer performance, not UAV-trained.
